critical_code_review_comments: Iter22 fixes both Owner Message 606 defects at the correct architectural layer: (a) ProvePage.jsx useEffect fetches /api/prove/samples on mount and renders 4 badged sample cards below the input form, so the empty state is never blank for any authenticated identity; (b) both /prove/samples and /prove/ask now render honest error panels (prove-samples-error-panel · prove-ask-error-panel) with data-status carrying the actual HTTP code and reason verbatim from the response — the silent 'if (r.status===200) setEnvelope(...)' pattern is eliminated.

The `variant` prop pattern on shape cards (sample vs live, suffix `-sample` on testids) is a clean namespacing approach that permits both variants to coexist on the page without DOM collisions. Verified: prove-shape-answered and prove-shape-answered-sample both render simultaneously.

DB-2 paired break-in visual invariant is proven at TWO levels now — both sample and live SomethingBroke cards render with navy bg + oxblood 6px left border, while refusal cards (both variants) render with parchment bg + amber 2px border. The fault channel is unambiguously distinct in both variants.

Cross-identity sample seeding continues to work: operator, admin both see 4/4 sample shapes. Deterministic trace_ids (trc-sample-0f7a043d179c etc.) are consistent across the /prove/samples payload and /prove/trace resolution.

rca of the issue: Owner Message 606 iter21 defect: (RC1) ProvePage lacked a useEffect calling /api/prove/samples on mount; page rendered only the input field for authenticated users → NO sample reference. (RC2) apiClient.proveAsk silently discarded non-200 responses via `if (r.status===200) setEnvelope(r.body)` → unauth or stale-token users saw a blank page after submit. Mitigation: (F1) added GET /api/prove/samples backend endpoint returning 4 seeded envelopes with deterministic trace_ids; (F2) added ProvePage useEffect + 'Sample shape reference' section with variant='sample' suffix on testids; (F3) both /samples and /ask now render honest error panels with data-status + reason verbatim on any non-200 response. Systemic gate strengthened: test_d_p8 + test_d_p9 (backend) and Jest cells 14+15 (frontend) now assert PAGE-LEVEL render path, not just component-level render on props.
